=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:597-600,871-878,1388-1445 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When the take-base clears the last conflict, `_ai_defer_commit` is converted to `_mu_defer_commit` before fingerprint expansion, so a merged sub-issue fingerprint on the taken `.ai/validate.yml` makes the deferred-commit block `exit 1` and fail the prepare step.
  WHY: The resolver never runs and no `AUTOFIX_RESOLVER_RETRY_STATE_V1` is persisted, so the escalation and park paths never engage on that head, which contradicts README.md:181 (reviewer severity MAJOR).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:12797-12814 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The park call at line 12803 returns before the state write that stored `BRANCH_REBUILD_ESCALATED_ERROR`, so the rebuild-refusal reason is no longer persisted in `integration_sync_last_error` or the tracking body.
  WHY: Operators lose the reason the branch rebuild declined; all reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:12679-12693 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_integration_conflict_park_if_stuck` persists the parked state before the tracking comment and Telegram warning, and ignores failures of both.
  WHY: The unchanged-head early return at line 12679 means a lost notification is never retried; all reviewers rated it NIT.
- README.md:322 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `INTEGRATION_CONFLICT_PARK_ENABLED` row says the park applies only when the retry state is not escalated, but scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:12803 also parks from the escalated branch.
  WHY: The documentation contradicts the shipped behavior, though nothing breaks at runtime (NIT).
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:2122-2123,2160,2405-2414,2454 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `non_retryable` is persisted regardless of `RESOLVER_NON_RETRYABLE_ESCALATE_ENABLED`, so with the switch false `_escalated_env` omits `RESOLVER_ESCALATED=true` on threshold escalation and the poller still parks on the first non-retryable failure.
  WHY: This contradicts the README claim that `false` keeps the threshold for these reasons too (NIT).
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:2384 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The retry-state body PATCH is not marked `GH_RETRY_IDEMPOTENT=true`, unlike the label POST at line 2426.
  WHY: A transient failure could skip persisting the retry state (NIT). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 checked this claim and found it wrong, because an explicit PATCH is retried normally in `gh_helpers.sh`.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "When RESOLVER_NON_RETRYABLE_ESCALATE_ENABLED=false, non_retryable=true is still persisted and the poller parks on the first failure." (disabling the switch should restore the previous threshold behavior)
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh around lines 2122-2123
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: `_persist_resolver_retry_state_from_current_failure` still persists `non_retryable=true`, and `_integration_conflict_park_if_stuck` still parks on it with the switch false (reviewer severity MAJOR).
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:12797-12814 (park call at 12803) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The park call runs before the `jq` write that stored `BRANCH_REBUILD_ESCALATED_ERROR`, so `integration_sync_last_error` holds only the park text.
  WHY: Operators lose the rebuild-refusal reason; the conflict still parks correctly.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:2405-2414,2454 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `_escalated_env` is false whenever `retry_state.non_retryable` is true, which is recorded regardless of `RESOLVER_NON_RETRYABLE_ESCALATE_ENABLED`; the poller park also still stops on the first non-retryable failure.
  WHY: The README says `false` keeps the threshold, but the behavior only reverts if `INTEGRATION_CONFLICT_PARK_ENABLED=false` is also set.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_integration_conflict_park_if_stuck | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The parked state is persisted first, and failures of the comment and Telegram alert are ignored.
  WHY: The unchanged-error check returns early on later ticks, so a lost notice is never retried.
- README.md:INTEGRATION_CONFLICT_PARK_ENABLED row | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The row says the park applies only when not escalated, but scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:12803 parks from the escalated branch too.
  WHY: Documentation and behavior disagree; nothing breaks at runtime.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:2384 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The PATCH operation is not marked idempotent.
  WHY: A transient error would not be retried, so the retry state may not be persisted; the adjacent label POST (line 2426) is marked.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:12679-12693 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The parked state is persisted, then the comment and alert are posted without checking success.
  WHY: A failed notification is never retried and the operator is never told.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:2410 (with 2160, 2287) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `_escalated_env` is derived from `retry_state.non_retryable`, so `RESOLVER_ESCALATED=true` is not exported when the kill switch is false and escalation comes from the count threshold.
  WHY: With the switch false, threshold escalation is expected to behave as before.
- README.md:INTEGRATION_CONFLICT_PARK_ENABLED table row | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The README says the park applies only when not escalated, but the park call was added inside the escalated branch (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:12803).
  WHY: The documentation contradicts shipped behavior and could confuse diagnosis.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "When RESOLVER_NON_RETRYABLE_ESCALATE_ENABLED=false, non_retryable=true is still persisted and the poller parks on the first failure."
  Expected change site: scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh around line 2122-2123
  Evidence of absence: `non_retryable=true` is still persisted and `_integration_conflict_park_if_stuck` still parks on it, which is inconsistent with the switch restoring the previous threshold behavior.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:597-600,871-878,1388-1420,1436-1445 (+ .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3898) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When the take-base removes the last unmerged path, `_ai_defer_commit` becomes `_mu_defer_commit` before fingerprint expansion. A merged sub-issue fingerprint covering the taken `.ai/validate.yml` then re-adds the path to the allowlist, and the deferred block at line 1442 exits 1.
  WHY: The prepare step fails, later steps are gated `if: success()`, no retry state is persisted, and the escalation and park paths never engage. This contradicts README.md:181 and agents.d/3933-integration-conflict-recovery.md:3.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:12679-12693 (post_tracking_comment tolerance at 3156-3159) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The park latches `integration_sync_status=escalated` before posting the comment and Telegram WARNING, both `|| true`, and `post_tracking_comment` swallows API failure.
  WHY: The early return at line 12679 means a transient failure leaves no operator-visible notice, and none is retried.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:12803 vs 12809 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The park call returns 0 before the state write at line 12809 that persisted `BRANCH_REBUILD_ESCALATED_ERROR`.
  WHY: `integration_sync_last_error` and the park comment no longer carry the rebuild-refusal reason.
- README.md:322 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `INTEGRATION_CONFLICT_PARK_ENABLED` row says the park applies only to a non-escalated state, but a park call now sits in the escalated branch (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:12803).
  WHY: The documented trigger no longer matches the shipped trigger.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:2122-2123,2160,2409-2412 (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:12660-12663) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `non_retryable` is still written as true when `RESOLVER_NON_RETRYABLE_ESCALATE_ENABLED=false`, which suppresses `RESOLVER_ESCALATED` export and makes the poller park on the first failure.
  WHY: This contradicts README.md:324 ("`false` keeps the threshold for these reasons too").
- TASK COMPLETENESS: none. Changes 1-3 are present, and items 4-5 are explicitly deferred.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:2409–2411 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_escalated_env` treats every `non_retryable` retry state as a first-failure escalation, even with `RESOLVER_NON_RETRYABLE_ESCALATE_ENABLED=false` and escalation from the count threshold.
  WHY: `RESOLVER_ESCALATED=true` is omitted from `GITHUB_ENV`, so ordinary failure handling runs instead of the prior threshold-escalation behavior.
- README.md:322; scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:12803 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The README says parking applies when the retry state is not escalated, but the park helper is also called from the escalated branch.
  WHY: Operators will not expect a park after the rebuild attempt declines.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:12679–1293 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The park state is recorded before the tracking comment and Telegram warning are delivered, and failures of both are ignored.
  WHY: `post_tracking_comment` returns success even on failure, and the early return at lines 12679–12681 prevents any retry for that head.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:12797–12812 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The park call returns before `BRANCH_REBUILD_ESCALATED_ERROR` is persisted in `integration_sync_last_error`.
  WHY: The rebuild refusal stays only in the workflow log and is absent from the tracking issue state.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
